parse_kitti_label_file: parse a KITTI label file and return a list of Object3d objects from each line
convert_cls_type_to_id: convert a KITTI class type string like Car or Pedestrian to its numeric ID
generate_3d_box_corners: generate the 8 3D corner coordinates of an object's bounding box in camera coordinates
classify_kitti_object_difficulty: classify a KITTI object detection as Easy, Moderate, or Hard based on truncation and occlusion
export_object_to_kitti_format: export an Object3d instance back to KITTI label format string for writing to a label file
